Twenty-five years post-9/11, the military commission trial for Khalid Sheikh Mohammed remains stalled in pretrial hearings at Guantánamo Bay with a tentative 2028 date.

Decades of state-sanctioned torture have legally poisoned key confessions, creating an inescapable procedural trap that denies closure to victims.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
This is a classic Plane Error, confusing procedural bureaucracy (HOW) with moral accountability (WHO). The system prioritizes institutional self-preservation over justice.

Social Physics Analysis:
The state runs a Smart Selfish Maneuver, hiding systemic failures behind endless procedural pretexts while projecting blame onto legal constraints rather than acknowledging state torture.

When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. Institutional evasion replaces systemic closure.

The Unavoidable Truth: Torture made a clean, timely trial legally impossible.
The Unavoidable Lie: Justice is simply delayed due to complex routine litigation.
